parsed.note_claim: The man didn't say 'Come here tiger. Kill me.' — that was a bystander's interpretation of his body language.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: He had his arms wide open like he was saying: 'Come here tiger. Kill me.'
parsed.reason: The page shows the phrase was a bystander's interpretation of the man's body language ('like he was saying'), not something the man actually said.
